patch.value: Preserve partial evaluation receipts and call counts on interruption

An endpoint timeout stops evaluation safely before configuration persistence, but completed observations and the attempted-call count are not returned. A bounded run then needs an external access log to reconstruct its spent budget. Follow-up: emit a redacted partial receipt and explicit attempted/completed counts on failure or interruption, without fitting or saving from incomplete evidence.

A synthetic two-request run failing on the second request reports two attempts and one completed example, preserves hashes and validated observations, makes no configuration write and does not retry; the failure receipt excludes source text and local paths.
